contract.task_clause:
You've made a scientific theory that there is a force between all objects. This forcce has both a dark and light side. When will your theory be proven correct?
Option A: When you and many other Jedi have tested the hypothesis
Option B: Jean-Luc Skywalker drops Yoda during the day and he falls to the ground proving your theory.
Option C: You can never prove your theory to be correct only "yet to be proven wrong."
Option D: After you've repeated your experiment many times
